---
title: "Cars regression"
---



```{r}
#| include: false
data(cars)

```
# Regression

## Regression analysis using Matrix method

```{r}
#| echo: false
X<- cbind(1,cars$speed)
Y<-cars$dist


```

```{r}
#| echo: false
X_transpose<-t(X)


```

```{r}
#| echo: false
bhat<-solve(X_transpose%*%X) %*% X_transpose%*%Y
bhat
```

``` r
```

## Regression analysis using lm()

```{r}
#| echo: false 
model1<-lm(dist~speed, data=cars)
model1
```

## Results

The coefficient estimates produced by the two methods are the same.
